items.title: Goldman Sachs CEO succession planning faces one big problem
items.summary: Goldman Sachs is on top of Wall Street right now, advising on more than $1 trillion in merger deals and generating more than $12 billion in equities revenue in the first six months of the year alone.

items.title: Polymarket taps Goldman Sachs veteran Lisa Mantil to attract Wall Street liquidity
items.summary: Prediction market exchange Polymarket has hired a near three-decade Goldman Sachs veteran to help lead its push to attract Wall Street liquidity.

items.title: Trump’s municipal bond portfolio reaches as much as $1 billion as policy overlaps mount
items.summary: President Donald Trump is a creditor to hundreds of cities, hospitals, schools, utilities and other public institutions across the country — many of which are directly affected by decisions made by his own administration.

items.title: China has three new criteria for humanoid robot IPOs. Few, if any, meet them
items.summary: BEIJING — China's securities regulator is raising the bar for public listings of humanoid robot startups, according to three sources familiar with the CSRC's thinking.

items.title: ‘I have $400,000 in equity’: I’m 80. Should I sell my house because of dangerous stairs — or spend thousands renovating?
‘I’m never selling’: I’m 47 and buy bitcoin with every dollar I earn. Am I crazy?
I’m 77, pay rent and live off Social Security, but I help homeless people. Why are so many people going hungry?
‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
‘I’d rather be on a beach in Bali’: My husband resents my $8 million net worth. Should I pay for his retirement?
